begins: on a phone, their group’s Magnets already open; nobody told them anything about it

asked.prompt: Tell a friend how it went.

said.said: It's a word-magnet app. I tapped "situation" and the shared sentence now reads "I can explain the situation." The group can see and change it. Tapping a word in the sentence removes it.
I expected a sentence game with a pile of words to tap. I didn't know it was shared with a group until I read the line at the bottom. It was what I expected, apart from that.

I found a simple shared sentence, "I can explain the ____", with magnet words like goose, invoice and raccoon. I made it "I can explain the situation." Nothing was confusing, and the instructions were clear.
